records.name: ClosedById
records.Name: ClosedById
records.Description:
An Employee is a person that can login to InSite, perform transactions, and/or be credited with work.  The Employees must have a Windows NT account. Once defined, the user will then appear in the user list within the Modeler Security window. In this way the Employee definition feeds directly into the Modeler Security.

The Employee definitions also allow for other options for each user such as the factory associate with the user and the language that will be used.  Persons that will get credited with work by being entered in the employee field on a transaction, must exist as InSite employees, but are not required to exist as Windows user accounts.

Through the use of Menu Definitions the needs of different groups of employees can be met in a factory.
